subject: Summer Newsletter and Listening Sessions
overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee approved and finalized its summer newsletter and discussed recent resident feedback from various community listening sessions.

items.title: Summer Newsletter Draft
items.summary: The committee approved and authorized the distribution of the June-September 2025 newsletter draft after making several corrections to the text.

items.title: Discussion of Resident Listening Sessions
items.summary: Committee members shared updates on recent listening sessions at the Senior Center and highlighted resident feedback regarding public works, zoning, and tree maintenance.
